articles.title: Five words: Steve Ballmer Jumbotron Corruption Scandal.
articles.summary:
All you really need to know here is Pablo Torre and his team won a Pulitzer Prize for exposing how Steve Ballmer’s LA Clippers paid star Kawhi Leonard under the table through a tree-planting operation called Aspiration that never planted a tree. Same story, only this time it’s the world’s largest 4K stadium display. Incredible stuff.
[Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w3Ksw0IC4CQ]
